policy: Entries are EXACT (path, kind, sha256-of-value) triples, each with a why. The value itself is never stored. Never add a pattern or a family: add the one exact triple for the one finding you verified benign (`python3 scripts/check-redaction-aperture.py --hash '<exact value>'` prints the hash). allow_any entries drop the path pin and are reserved for values that are benign everywhere (e.g. the operator's own published username).

disabled_kinds.phone: Measured 2026-09-28 on master 8c0e1bf5: 2,890 findings / 325 files, all sampled benign — byte-size constants (1048576, 1073741824), SVG path coordinates, calendar timestamps ('2026-09-26 12') collide with the 10-15-digit phone shape. The class remains ACTIVE in the local corpus projection pipeline (corpus-public-projection.py), which is where real phone-shaped material (archive rows) actually flows; re-enable here with --all-kinds or by deleting this entry.
disabled_kinds.ipv4: Measured 2026-09-28: 52 findings / 36 files, all sampled benign — 4-part version strings ('0.1.3.0' style in manifests/control) and the loopback address in smoke tools/docs. Version bumps would false-red every release, so the class is off by default.
disabled_kinds.wallet: Measured 2026-09-28: 65 findings / 5 files, all sampled benign — base64 runs inside art payloads and manifest blobs (painting.html, foundry/p/4.txt) and Google-Drive-shaped ids collide with the BTC legacy shape. Base64 data collides by construction on this repo.
